name: Human handoff and appointment coordination
trigger: Caller requests a human or agent reaches limit

steps.action: Check agent availability or approved booking system
Transfer via verified telephony path or create follow-up

output: Confirmed transfer, booking or assigned follow-up
acceptance_tests: Transfer failure has a safe fallback
notes: Human task fallback uses the baseline. Easy!Appointments remains conditional.
failure: Fail closed for new calls; terminate or hand off an active call safely under policy. Reconcile carrier and ARI state before any redial. Preserve opt-out immediately.

run_contract.owner: Assigned accountable role in OpenProject before activation
run_contract.retry: Bounded retry only after retryability classification; unknown remote effects HOLD
run_contract.observability: workflow_id, run_id, correlation_id, state and redacted error; no raw PII labels
run_contract.recovery: Restore HOLD; reapply suppression/deletion and reconcile external receipts before replay
run_contract.completion: Named output plus acceptance evidence, not merely a running service
